about: Serialised delivery of the Womb with a View antenatal comic series: one comic per antenatal contact, or one per month of pregnancy, whichever cadence the programme runs. David Levine, 2026-08-20: 'prioritize toothbrushing, handwashing, and Womb with a View -- one comic / month or per ANC visit.'
seriesSource: ANC Comics Womb with a View.10 (David I. Levine, 2016), unpublished

policy.neverShowsAComicBeforeItsMilestoneNote: A caregiver may always read ahead. The schedule decides what is offered first, not what is permitted - withholding a mother's own health information to enforce a drip feed would be the wrong trade.

notYetRecovered.note: The source file is named 'Womb with a View.10', so the series is longer than the two comics recovered from pull request #28. The rest are not in this build. The app says so on the antenatal screen rather than showing an empty slot or silently repeating a comic, because a caregiver who is told 'the next one comes at your next visit' and then finds nothing has been lied to.
